categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and touches transaction creation logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/types.h.
categories.rationale: Avoids a redundant coin selection pass and corrects tracepoint metrics when ungrouped selection leaves no partial spends. As noted in issue #25150, the wallet unconditionally runs a second APS pass even when no partial spend occurred, causing extra computation and misleading tracepoint telemetry.
